meta.title: hotkeygo — Your words. Sharper.
meta.description: A native macOS menu-bar utility for selected text. Fix it in place, transform it with Actions, or understand it with read-only Peek.

hero.subBody: Select text anywhere on macOS, press one shortcut, and fix, rewrite, or translate it instantly.

modes.fixCopy: Typos, tone, translation. Tap once — repeat last action. Tap twice — the palette. Replace, insert below, or open in a card.

landing.heroBody: Fix selected text in place, choose an intentional transformation, or use read-only Peek to understand it. Then keep working.
landing.heroNote: FAST BY WORKFLOW · PRIVATE BY DESIGN

race.title: Skip the round trip.
race.lead: A chat needs a copy, an app switch, a prompt, and a trip back. A typical hotkeygo action takes 3–5 seconds, depending on what you ask it to do.

chatReasons.switchBack: Back to the app you never had to leave.
chatReasons.end: Welcome back. We saved you a seat.

race.footerMeta: NO CHAT WINDOW · NO COPY-PASTE RETURN TRIP

landing.fastBody: No chat. No prompting. No copy-paste loop. Select, shortcut, continue.
landing.privateBody: Selected text, prompts, and results stay out of hotkeygo’s app storage and logs. No account is required.
landing.workBody: Fix makes the smallest safe edit. Actions changes text only when you choose. Peek helps you understand it without changing the source.
landing.fixBody: Your voice, minus the typo. Conservative corrections replace the selection in place.
landing.actionsBody: Choose a translation or writing change. Actions replaces your selection with the result.
landing.peekBody: Translate or explain selected text in a read-only card. The source stays unchanged.
landing.privacyBody: Concrete privacy behavior. No magic words, no dramatic promises.
landing.transient: Selected text is processed only when you trigger hotkeygo.
landing.notLogged: hotkeygo doesn’t store or log selected text, prompts, or model results.
landing.pricingBody: Thirty actions arrive each calendar month. Unlimited is there when hotkeygo becomes muscle memory.
landing.unlimitedBody: No action counter. Just the shortcut.
landing.footerUtility: FAST BY WORKFLOW · PRIVATE BY DESIGN
